title: Discovery crawler + form/page classification
acceptance_criteria: Playwright chromium crawler, same-origin only, with configurable depth and max-page limits; renders each page (does not trust HTTP status)
Produces a site map: pages visited, links, buttons, forms with their fields (type, name, autocomplete, aria, labels, visible text)
Classifies each form as signup vs login vs other using visible text, ARIA roles/labels, input types & autocomplete, URL hints, and form shape (2 password fields => signup)
Site map cached per host but re-validated on each run
Unit tests for form/field classification cover signup vs login vs other on representative HTML fixtures; pytest green
Runs against http://localhost:8889 and correctly identifies /register as signup and /login as login (evidence in report/stdout, no secrets)
